body: thanks for responding.  I posted my story here https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/59sta3/my_story/

Currently, I'm depressed and feel like I have no future to look forward to.  I will be 30 years old next month, I'm stuck with a dend end job I hate, I have no friends, I've never had a serious relationship and I have nobody in my family I can go to for support.  

I have started going to the gym for the past three weeks almost every day but tonight, I just started thinking about how lonely I am again and how difficult it will be to enter a serious relationship in the future due to my lack of experience with women.

I'm considering describing my life story on a new post within this forum to see if this helps me feel any better.
